Description
Bannister Mews is one of the most distinguished townhome developments in Kerrisdale in recent years. Located at Arbutus and W.49th built within a retained and restored historic stone wall, this project combines architectural cues that exemplify characters of this historic neighbourhood with modern luxurious interior design. This 1,271sf, 3 levels, 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms townhouse features hardwood and engineered laminate floors throughout. Up the foyer to the main living area is the huge rectangular living room, dining area with ceiling fan and kitchen. The gourmet kitchen comes with shaker wood cabinetry, granite countertop, stainless steel Bosch and Fisher & Paykel appliances. Note: no more than two unrelated occupants are allowed for insurance restrictions reasons.

Description
Nestled on one of Kitsilano's most picturesque and sought-after streets, this exceptional two-level townhome is located just one block from the beach on charming York Avenue, surrounded by cherry blossom trees and beautiful executive residences. Offering approximately 1,499 sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space, this home features 2 bedrooms, a den, 2 bathrooms, and stunning views of the water, mountains, and city skyline. The main level offers an inviting open-concept kitchen, a spacious dining area ideal for entertaining, a private deck, and a well-appointed bedroom and full bathroom. A private rooftop deck provides the perfect setting to relax. One covered carport parking space included. If viewing on Zillow please text/email the leasing agent. **Unfurnished is not an option**

Welcome to this exceptional Net-Zero front half-duplex in Point Grey, designed by Marrimor Interiors & built by True Maple Construction. Defined by high-performance sustainability & bespoke craft, the sun-lit main floor features a chef’s kitchen with integrated Miele appliances, custom millwork, & an oversized island. Upstairs, 3 bedrooms each enjoy a private ensuite with radiant in-floor heating, highlighted by a serene primary suite with a spa-inspired bath & WIC. The top level opens to a private balcony framing North Shore mountain & skyline views. Complete with 4 baths, central A/C, crawl space storage, & an EV garage. Steps from W 10th shops, cafes, top schools, UBC, Jericho Beach & Spanish Banks. If viewing on Zillow please text or email the leasing agent.

Unfurnished 4-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom detached home in MacKenzie Heights, Vancouver. Approx. 3,149 sq ft with all four bedrooms upstairs, including a primary bedroom with ensuite. Spacious kitchen and adjoining family room overlook a private south-facing backyard. Lower-level recreation space, storage and laundry. Carpet replaced July 2025; entire house repainted. Fridge, stove, oven, dishwasher, washer and dryer included. Rent $6,000/month plus utilities. Available after October 16, 2026; exact move-in date to be confirmed. Minimum one-year lease. No pets or smoking. Tenant insurance, credit and reference checks required.
